title: Consolidation: Beats, Festivals & Living Slang: Youth Culture Since the 1960s

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize the evolution of Hungarian youth countercultures from the 1960s beat era to modern digital vernacular.
I can flexibly employ expressive twin-words (ikerszók) and colloquial intensifiers while respecting register boundaries.
I can discuss how music, countercultural clubs, and festivals shaped Hungarian civil identity across generations.
